registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Trend adoption across multiple scales: 4h structural trend filtered by EMA20/50 and slope; 1h structural trend confirmation; 15m non-chase entry with 2 consecutive bars of aligned taker buy volume pressure.

math_formulation.long_entry: (4h_close > 4h_EMA20 > 4h_EMA50) and (4h_EMA20 - 4h_EMA20[3] > 0) and (1h_close > 1h_EMA20) and (15m_return < 1.5*15m_ATR) and (15m_signed_taker_ratio > 0.15 for last 2 bars)
math_formulation.short_entry: (4h_close < 4h_EMA20 < 4h_EMA50) and (4h_EMA20 - 4h_EMA20[3] < 0) and (1h_close < 1h_EMA20) and (15m_return > -1.5*15m_ATR) and (15m_signed_taker_ratio < -0.15 for last 2 bars)

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Net bps <= 0 under 44 bp stress roundtrip, profit factor < 1.15, or failure across equal-weighted calendar years.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Persistent order flow imbalance: 3 consecutive 15m bars with sustained signed taker ratio > 0.10 (or < -0.10) accompanied by volume > 1.2x 20-bar average, aligned with 4h EMA20 > EMA50 trend regime.
registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Taker pressure fails to sustain drift beyond 44 bp roundtrip cost; net bps <= 0 or trade count < 100.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Breakout and retest acceptance: 4h 20-bar Donchian channel breakout within last 12h, followed by a pullback retest touching within 0.5 * 1h ATR of the breakout level, followed by immediate 15m re-affirmation with positive taker flow.

math_formulation.long_entry: (Recent 4h breakout of 20-bar high) and (15m_low <= 4h_prev_high + 0.5*1h_ATR) and (15m_close > 4h_prev_high) and (15m_signed_taker_ratio > 0.10)
math_formulation.short_entry: (Recent 4h breakout of 20-bar low) and (15m_high >= 4h_prev_low - 0.5*1h_ATR) and (15m_close < 4h_prev_low) and (15m_signed_taker_ratio < -0.10)

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Chop and false retests cause repeated stop outs, yielding negative stress net bps.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Volatility expansion momentum: After volatility compression (1h ATR(14) / ATR(56) < 0.75), an expansion bar triggers with ATR expansion > 1.25x and price breakout of 20-bar 1h channel, entry gated by chase limit (< 1.0 * ATR).
registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Post-expansion mean reversion causes drawdown > 12% or negative net returns under stress costs.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Cross-session momentum continuation: At London open (08:00 UTC) or NY open (13:00 UTC), if the preceding 2 1h bars showed strong unidirectional momentum with above-average volume (> 1.2x) and aligned flow, enter for 8h continuation.

math_formulation.long_entry: (hour in {8, 13}) and (last 2 1h bars: close > open and vol > 1.2 * 1h_vol_SMA20 and signed_taker_ratio > 0.10)
math_formulation.short_entry: (hour in {8, 13}) and (last 2 1h bars: close < open and vol > 1.2 * 1h_vol_SMA20 and signed_taker_ratio < -0.10)

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Session opens result in mean-reverting traps ('fakeouts') rather than sustained trend continuation.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Secular 24h trend riding: Strong 4h trend (EMA20 > EMA50, ADX > 25), cumulative 4-hour signed taker flow > 0, shallow pullback entry on 15m bar touching 1h EMA20.

math_formulation.long_entry: (4h_EMA20 > 4h_EMA50) and (4h_ADX > 25) and (cumulative 4h signed taker volume > 0) and (15m_low <= 1h_EMA20 <= 15m_high) and (15m_close > 1h_EMA20)
math_formulation.short_entry: (4h_EMA20 < 4h_EMA50) and (4h_ADX > 25) and (cumulative 4h signed taker volume < 0) and (15m_low <= 1h_EMA20 <= 15m_high) and (15m_close < 1h_EMA20)

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: 24h horizon suffers deep intra-trade drawdowns and fails 12% max MTM DD limit, or has net bps <= 0.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Volume-weighted momentum breakout: 1h close breaks above 24h rolling VWAP by > 0.5 * 1h ATR with volume surge (> 1.5x 20h SMA) and strong signed taker flow (> 0.15). Symmetrical short for break below VWAP.
registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Volume surge leads to immediate liquidity exhaustion and reversal under 44 bp stress.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Regime transition from consolidation to directional expansion: 4h ADX(14) was below 18 for >= 3 bars (chop) and crosses above 20 with DI directional confirmation and 1h 12-hour high/low breakout.
registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Chop exit signals produce false starts that quickly collapse back into range.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Cumulative Volume Delta (CVD) momentum confirmation: 12h price breakout accompanied by simultaneous new 12h high in cumulative taker buy volume delta, verifying aggressive buying dominance.
registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Aggressive CVD surges fail to sustain drift and suffer negative net returns under stress fees.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Trend continuation on shallow pullbacks: In a 4h structural trend (EMA20 > EMA50 and close > EMA20), enter on a 15m pullback touching the 20-bar 1h Donchian midline when 15m close recovers with positive flow (> 0.10).
registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Midline pullbacks break through into deep trend reversals, hitting stop losses.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Calibrated volatility expansion: 1h ATR compression (< 0.85 of 56-bar ATR) followed by 1h expansion (> 1.2x SMA10) with volume confirmation (> 1.5x) and 15m taker flow confirmation.

math_formulation.long_entry: (min(1h_ATR14/1h_ATR56 in prior 12h) < 0.85) and (1h_ATR14 > 1.20 * 1h_ATR14_SMA10) and (1h_vol > 1.5 * 1h_vol_SMA20) and (1h_close > 1h_high_20) and (15m_signed_taker_ratio > 0.10)
math_formulation.short_entry: (min(1h_ATR14/1h_ATR56 in prior 12h) < 0.85) and (1h_ATR14 > 1.20 * 1h_ATR14_SMA10) and (1h_vol > 1.5 * 1h_vol_SMA20) and (1h_close < 1h_low_20) and (15m_signed_taker_ratio < -0.10)

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Sample size remains under 100 or net bps under stress fails to exceed 0.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Liquidity sweep exhaustion into trend: In 4h uptrend (EMA20 > EMA50), a temporary sharp sell-off occurs with 15m signed taker ratio < -0.30 and long lower wick (rejection), entering on the next 15m bar with positive flow (> 0.10). Symmetrical short for buying climax into downtrend.

math_formulation.long_entry: (4h_EMA20 > 4h_EMA50) and (prev 15m: flow < -0.30 and lower_wick > 2 * upper_wick) and (current 15m: close > prev_close and flow > 0.10)
math_formulation.short_entry: (4h_EMA20 < 4h_EMA50) and (prev 15m: flow > 0.30 and upper_wick > 2 * lower_wick) and (current 15m: close < prev_close and flow < -0.10)

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Counter-trend momentum continues through stop loss, failing to revert to higher timeframe trend.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Fresh 1h moving average cross aligned with 4h macro trend: 1h EMA10 crosses 1h EMA30 within the last 2 hours, confirmed by 4h EMA20 > EMA50, and current 15m signed flow ratio > 0.20.
registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: MA crosses suffer from whipsaws and lagging entries under 44 bp stress fees.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Efficiency ratio transition: Kaufman ER on 1h bars surges from chop (< 0.30 in prior 12h) to directional trend (> 0.65), entering in the direction of the price change with 15m taker flow confirmation.
registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: ER surges represent terminal exhaustion moves rather than persistent trends.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Volatility squeeze explosion: 1h Bollinger Bandwidth hits a 30-bar low, followed by a close breaking outside the outer band with volume > 1.5x and 15m signed flow > 0.15.
registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Bandwidth squeezes produce false breakouts with negative net returns after 44 bp friction.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: Asymmetric long trend riding: Exploit BTC structural upward drift in bull regimes. Require 4h EMA20 > EMA50, 1h close > EMA20, 1h ATR expanding, and 2 consecutive 15m bars of strong taker buy flow (> 0.15).

math_formulation.long_entry: (4h_EMA20 > 4h_EMA50) and (1h_close > 1h_EMA20) and (1h_ATR14 > 1h_ATR14_SMA10) and (all last 2 15m bars: signed_taker_ratio > 0.15)

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Long-only bias fails during bear year (2022) with equal-year net bps <= 0 or drawdown > 12%.

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Cascade extensions reverse sharply (short squeeze) resulting in stop hits under stress.

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Session pullbacks continue moving against position, failing 44 bp stress roundtrip.

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Dual expansion produces insufficient edge to cover 44 bp roundtrip friction.

registered_parameters.economic_rationale: 24h rolling VWAP acceleration: Price holds above 24h VWAP for 3 consecutive 1h bars with positive VWAP slope and 15m signed flow > 0.20. Symmetrical short for below VWAP with negative slope.
registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: VWAP drift stalls and mean-reverts back through stop loss.

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: MACD momentum ignition lags and suffers negative net returns under stress fees.

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Breakouts fail and tight stops trigger frequently, yielding negative net bps.

registered_parameters.falsification_criteria: Flow surges fail to predict directional continuation beyond 44 bp stress roundtrip.
